summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Roofline Phase-1 Foundation. 13/13 backend pytest tests passed on the public URL; UI flow (Checkpoint dashboard, Dataset Gallery, Annotation Studio point-assist -> plane addition -> overlay toggle -> Approve -> status=approved, prev/next navigation, save indicator) all working. House-grouping bug fix verified: method is 'orb_features + ransac_homography_inliers' with real ORB/RANSAC evidence candidates.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes multiple resource groups (dataset, housegroups, annotations, ml) in a single 333-line file; still under 700 but consider splitting by router for maintainability.
Approve endpoint blocks on ml.generate_and_store in threadpool - fine for CPU fallback but should be documented as sync-heavy.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Approving 0001 persists status=approved; 0169 is now needs_review; a HG-M merged group exists for images 0005 and 0195. Split leakage still passes. Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env.
